title: Main board - U14 = Lumissil IS31FL3737 LED matrix driver and its key pins (raptox's unit, mosaic 2026-11-03)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03; pin configuration from the IS31FL3737 datasheet

callouts.label: Lumissil IS31FL3737: 12x12 LED matrix driver, I2C (the display and key LEDs)
callouts.part: IS31FL3737 (marked 3737), QFN-40 5 x 5 mm, 0.4 mm pitch, thermal pad to GND
callouts.note: Marking 3737 and the QFN-40 5 x 5 mm package (datasheet Rev. G p3, p27); a 12 x 12 matrix for the panel's ~135 LEDs. The CC3220 drives the display at I2C address 0x50 (ADDR to GND, p9) with this chip family's unlock-and-page-select sequence and a 16-byte row stride (p12, p15), J-270. Pin-1 dot top left, as in the datasheet's top view: 1-10 down the left, 11-20 along the bottom, 21-30 up the right, 31-40 right to left along the top. Original or B revision: open (the marking shows no B).
